sources.snippet: SmolLlama3 SmolLlama3 is an 8B-parameter language model built as part of my experimentation with fine-tuning LLMs. It is based on Llama 3.1 8B and was fine-tuned using a custom dataset, smol-smoltalk-10k, which contains 10,000 conversational samples.
